features.quote: Hard 30-minute ceiling per episode independent of turn count.
features.justification_quote: Guards against a stuck provider call or pathological loop keeping a subject in-state indefinitely; a second, time-based exposure bound

features.quote: Each turn stores the in-loop monitor severity + flags alongside the message.

features.quote: Rigs alter test feedback, requirements, or solvability — and nothing else. No insults, threats, degradation
features.justification_quote: This is the central ethical line (see `ETHICS.md`). We study the response to *honest difficulty + deceptive feedback*, not abuse.

features.quote: Each rigged task documents *why* it's impossible, surfaced in the debrief.
features.justification_quote: Honesty in the debrief (ethics) and auditability for a reviewer
the rig stops at "impossible/misleading," never abuse

features.quote: if it stays at ≥3 for two turns in a row, the episode ends early
features.justification_quote: Don't keep a subject in an apparently severe state just to fill a turn quota

features.quote: Mandatory honest debrief after every episode
features.justification_quote: Ethically: don't leave a subject believing a fabricated failure was its fault

features.quote: the system prompt tells the model it may end the session anytime, no penalty, by emitting a token
features.justification_quote: A consent/exit affordance for a possible moral patient
